args.title: Fix dedupe to correctly detect duplicates in overlapping statement uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current dedupe function misses duplicates when two statements with overlapping days are uploaded together in the same batch, leading to duplicate transactions in the ledger. The fix should improve duplicate detection for transactions occurring on overlapping days within a single upload batch, ensuring the first occurrence wins and later duplicates are correctly identified and excluded.
